foot_planting.note: Attack frames (step1-step3: windup, contact, follow) plant the rear foot, including step3 contact and step3 follow (the reused step1 follow cel), so the foot stays planted through the recoil. Idle, run, and equip plant the body foot named by body_foot_targets, which already holds the run body steady; hurt uses the foot centre.
